_readme: OPTIONAL sourced expectations, keyed by TMDB id (as a string).
THIS STORE IS NOT THE PRIMARY MECHANISM AND IS NOT MEANT TO GROW LARGE.
The normal workflow needs nothing here: a release claims IMAX, the verifier measures the
actual frames, and the frames decide. The file is the final authority.
Add an entry only when a sourced fact genuinely improves on that -- for example when a
specific edition is known to be expanded for its WHOLE runtime, so a partial result should
be treated as wrong rather than merely unusual.
REQUIRED for an entry to have any authority (see _sourced() in imax_verify.py):
source_url    a real reference. Not a guess, not a reconstructed link.
confidence    'high' or 'medium'. Anything else is treated as advisory.
An entry missing either is ADVISORY ONLY: it is recorded and shown, and can never cause a
FAIL. Never invent an expectation to fill a gap -- UNKNOWN is a legitimate answer.
Fields:
title                display name, for reports
tmdb_id              same as the key, for readability
edition              which release this describes, e.g. 'UHD Blu-ray', 'WEB-DL (Disney+)'.
Editions differ: a Disney+ IMAX Enhanced stream and a disc can carry
different framing for the same film.
mode                 'variable' | 'full' | 'none'
expected_ratio       the expanded ratio to look for (1.43 / 1.78 / 1.90)
base_ratio           variable only: the non-expanded ratio, usually 2.39
min_expanded_share   fraction of usable samples that must be expanded
(variable default 0.10, full default 0.80)
tolerance            +/- when matching a ratio, default 0.06
source_url           reference for the claim
confidence           high | medium | low
notes                anything a future reader needs
Prefer official IMAX or studio information where it exists, particularly for Disney+ IMAX
Enhanced titles. Do not scrape disc-database pages: brittle, and not worth the coupling.
EXAMPLE of a well-formed entry (not active; the key is prefixed so it is ignored):

example-155.title: The Dark Knight
example-155.notes: IMAX sequences run full-height while the rest stays scope. Verified measurement on the local copy: 2.4 for 73%, 1.78 for 17% (~26 min).
